title: workflow.task.resolved payload
description: Emitted by BMS when something other than its completion in Notifications ends a workflow's task: a review step's verdict in MAM (EP-22.6) closes it DONE with the verdict as its outcome; the step timing out, or its workflow failing while the task is open, closes it CANCELLED (EP-22.9). Consumed by Notifications, which closes the task.

state.description: How the task ends. Absent means done — what BMS sent before EP-22.9.

outcome.description: For a done task: the verdict, "approved" or "rejected". Absent on a cancellation.

reason.description: For a cancellation: why — `timeout` (the step's timeout fired) or `workflow-ended` (its workflow failed while the task was open).

by.description: Who gave the verdict — a user id, or `mam` for an automatic approval.

reviewPointId.description: The point the verdict named; absent when it named none (it then resolves every review step waiting on the asset).
